run_lvis_cat_info: run the LVIS category info tool to compute image and instance counts per category from an annotation file
run_lvis_cat_info_freq: run the LVIS category info tool with frequency labels (rare, common, frequent) based on image count thresholds
run_lvis_cat_info_custom_paths: run the LVIS category info tool with custom annotation and output JSON file paths
run_lvis_cat_info_custom_thresholds: run the LVIS category info tool with custom rare and common image count thresholds for frequency classification
summarize_lvis_cat_info: summarize the LVIS category info script that enriches category data with image count, instance count, and optional frequency labels
